drive.detail: Downloaded 2026-10-19 to data/recordings/drive_2026-10-19/ (9 files). Sizes equal Drive's reported lengths; zips pass integrity test; SHA-256 compared with local copies. Folder ID ends in an underscore (earlier 404s used the ID without it). 5 of 6 CSVs are byte-identical to local copies; the session-2 EOG file on Drive is a truncated byte-prefix of the complete Desktop copy (29,360,128 of 53,329,920 bytes). Also present: 2 Muse mindMonitor zips and a 13.6 s MP4 whose content has NOT been inspected.

identity_notes: File names suggest two different volunteers ('Muku' vs 'Mithin') - this is an inference from names only; no participant metadata exists in the files.
Each session has three independent SensorTile logs (ECG/EMG/EOG label = intended electrode wiring). Each tile has its own clock starting near 0 us; no shared timestamps.
Session-2 logs end in one truncated row each (dropped, <=5-row policy in src/ingest/sensortile.py). Raw files untouched.
Drive retrieval (2026-10-19): the session-2 EOG file on Drive (1179.2 s) is a byte-prefix of the Desktop EOG file (2131.9 s); the Desktop file is the complete one.
Muse exports (mindMonitor zips) have ~1 raw EEG row/s and no sync event shared with SensorTile; no alignment between any SensorTile tile and the Muse logs is established.

drive_history.detail: gdown (unauthenticated) -> HTTP 404 (folder not public; editor sharing does not make it public). claude.ai Google Drive connector requires OAuth: run /mcp and authorise 'claude.ai Google Drive'. Until then it is unknown whether the Desktop 'Mithin' files are the Drive files.
drive_history.note: Superseded. The 404 was caused by an incorrectly entered folder ID (trailing underscore dropped), not by permissions; see drive.

all_distinct_note: 'all_distinct' refers to the six local SensorTile files only; Drive copies repeat five of them by design.
